summary: This note is a short biographical entry for Bon "John" Phan, a Vietnamese-American professional poker player based in Stockton, California. It states his birth date and place and summarizes his tournament record: two World Series of Poker bracelets and a World Poker Tour Championships win along with four final table finishes.
one_line: Bon "John" Phan is a Vietnamese-American professional poker player from Stockton, California, with two WSOP bracelets and World Poker Tour Championships success.
key_facts: Bon "John" Phan was born on October 10, 1974, in Da Nang, Vietnam.
Bon "John" Phan is a Vietnamese-American professional poker player.
Bon "John" Phan is based in Stockton, California.
Bon "John" Phan is a two-time World Series of Poker bracelet winner.
Bon "John" Phan is a winner of the World Poker Tour Championships.
Bon "John" Phan has been a final tablist at the World Poker Tour Championships four times.
